svg.text: AtmosMesh Spot, first unit (In/Out + probe) — 14 × 20 holes, component-side view, USB toward row 1
One 3.3 V domain. Header positions are exact; passives sit in the rows named in wiring.md. Wiring by pin name is authoritative.
USB-C ▲ (pin names: type knowledge — verify on the silkscreen)
J_1W (5.08 mm terminal, wires exit bottom edge)
5.08 mm terminal, cable exits right edge
row 11: R_PU_SDA 2k2 · R_PU_SCL 2k2 · C1 100n at U1 3V3
row 14: TP_3V3 TP_GND TP_SDA TP_SCL · R_OUT_SDA 100R · R_OUT_SCL 100R
rows 15–16: D_CL ×4 1N5819 (SDA/SCL rail clamps) · C_OUT 100n · C_RAD_BULK 100µ · C_RAD 100n
row 19: J_RAD (radar stands upright, antenna face outward) · J_1W terminal
red = ceramic-antenna keep-out: no copper, no wire, no coating
grey ring = U1 socket pin (female 8-pin strips)
black = female header pin · grey block = screw-terminal pole
